QR_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Open WhatsApp on your phone → Linked devices → Link a device.
QR_MODAL.PAIRING_HINT: Or enter this pairing code on your phone instead of scanning.

ON_CONNECT.LABEL: Import automatically on connect
ON_CONNECT.DESCRIPTION: When the WhatsApp session becomes connected, start historical import in the background if contacts or messages import is enabled.

IMPORT.AUTO_ON_CONNECT_WARNING: Historical import may start automatically the next time this inbox connects to WhatsApp. Use "Run import now" for a manual run, or disable automatic import on connect.

CONTACTS.LABEL: Import contacts
CONTACTS.DESCRIPTION: Import WhatsApp contacts from Evolution when the session connects or when you run import manually.

MESSAGES.LABEL: Import messages
MESSAGES.DESCRIPTION: Import recent chat history per contact using Evolution findMessages.

DAYS_LIMIT.LABEL: Message history window (days)
DAYS_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: Only import messages from the last N days.

IMPORT.RUN_SUCCESS: Historical import started in the background.

GROUPS_IGNORE.LABEL: Ignore groups
GROUPS_IGNORE.DESCRIPTION: When enabled, group messages ({'@'}g.us) are not imported. Disable to receive group chats (requires format group messages for readability).
GROUPS_IGNORE.EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING: Group support is experimental: one conversation per group, participant names are prefixed in message text, and some features (templates, calls) may not work in groups.

REJECT_CALL.LABEL: Reject calls
REJECT_CALL.DESCRIPTION: Automatically reject incoming voice and video calls.

READ_MESSAGES.LABEL: Mark incoming as read on WhatsApp
READ_MESSAGES.DESCRIPTION: Mark messages as read in WhatsApp when they are received.

CONVERSATION_PENDING.LABEL: Start conversations as pending
CONVERSATION_PENDING.DESCRIPTION: New or reopened conversations start in pending status instead of open. The second customer message moves the conversation to open.

REOPEN_CONVERSATION.LABEL: Reopen conversation when receiving message
REOPEN_CONVERSATION.DESCRIPTION: When the contact messages again, reuse and reopen the same conversation instead of creating a new one after it was resolved.

SETTINGS.CONVERSATION_PENDING_REQUIRES_REOPEN: Enable "Reopen conversation when receiving message" above for pending status to apply when a resolved conversation is reopened. Without it, only brand-new conversations start as pending.

OPERATIONAL_NOTES.TEMPLATES: WhatsApp Business templates are sent as plain text when template mode is enabled. Native template submission is not supported.
OPERATIONAL_NOTES.RECONCILIATION: Lost message sync checks the last 6 hours and up to 20 pages of Evolution history about every 30 minutes when enabled.
OPERATIONAL_NOTES.PARTIAL_ATTACHMENTS: If one attachment in a multi-file message fails to send, earlier files may already be delivered and a private note is added.

SETTINGS.SYNC_ERROR: Settings were saved in Chatwoot but could not be synced to Evolution: {error}

SEND_TEMPLATES_AS_TEXT.LABEL: Send templates as plain text
SEND_TEMPLATES_AS_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Convert WhatsApp template messages to plain text sends when the provider cannot submit templates.

IGNORE_FROM_ME_ECHO.LABEL: Ignore phone-sent echoes
IGNORE_FROM_ME_ECHO.DESCRIPTION: When enabled, skips all messages sent from the connected WhatsApp phone. Leave disabled to show phone-sent messages as outgoing (Chatwoot agent replies are still deduplicated by message ID).

IGNORE_STATUS_BROADCAST.LABEL: Ignore status broadcasts
IGNORE_STATUS_BROADCAST.DESCRIPTION: Do not import WhatsApp status updates (status{'@'}broadcast).

SIGN_MSG.LABEL: Sign messages with agent name
SIGN_MSG.DESCRIPTION: Prefix outbound text with the agent display name, a colon, and a new line before the message body (e.g. "Jane Doe:\nHello").

CONVERT_MARKDOWN_OUTBOUND.LABEL: Convert markdown for WhatsApp
CONVERT_MARKDOWN_OUTBOUND.DESCRIPTION: Transform Chatwoot markdown (bold, italic) into WhatsApp formatting before sending.

CONVERT_MARKDOWN_INBOUND.LABEL: Convert WhatsApp formatting to markdown
CONVERT_MARKDOWN_INBOUND.DESCRIPTION: Transform WhatsApp formatting into Chatwoot markdown when receiving messages.

MARK_READ_ON_REPLY.LABEL: Mark incoming as read when agent replies
MARK_READ_ON_REPLY.DESCRIPTION: When replying to a specific message, mark that WhatsApp message as read. If no reply target is set, marks the latest unread incoming message as read.

NOTIFY_SEND_ERRORS_PRIVATE.LABEL: Private note on send failure
NOTIFY_SEND_ERRORS_PRIVATE.DESCRIPTION: Add a private note to the conversation when a WhatsApp message fails to send.

SYNC_DELETE_TO_WHATSAPP.LABEL: Delete on WhatsApp when deleted in Chatwoot
SYNC_DELETE_TO_WHATSAPP.DESCRIPTION: When an agent deletes a message in Chatwoot, delete it for everyone on WhatsApp.

SYNC_EDIT_TO_WHATSAPP.LABEL: Edit on WhatsApp when edited in Chatwoot
SYNC_EDIT_TO_WHATSAPP.DESCRIPTION: When message content changes in Chatwoot, push the new text to WhatsApp. Requires API or future UI edit flow.

SEND_RANDOM_DELAY.LABEL: Random send delay
SEND_RANDOM_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Wait 500–2000 ms before each outbound message to reduce automation patterns.

MERGE_BRAZIL_CONTACTS.LABEL: Merge Brazil phone variants
MERGE_BRAZIL_CONTACTS.DESCRIPTION: Match contacts with and without the mobile 9th digit for +55 numbers.

IGNORE_SURVEY_LINKS.LABEL: Ignore CSAT survey links
IGNORE_SURVEY_LINKS.DESCRIPTION: Drop inbound messages that contain Chatwoot survey response URLs.

SYNC_LOST_MESSAGES.LABEL: Reconcile missed messages
SYNC_LOST_MESSAGES.DESCRIPTION: Periodically compare Evolution chat history with Chatwoot and import messages missing from the last 6 hours.

FORMAT_GROUP_MESSAGES.LABEL: Format group participant names
FORMAT_GROUP_MESSAGES.DESCRIPTION: Prefix group messages with the sender name or phone when group chats are enabled.

READ_STATUS.LABEL: Mark status updates as read
READ_STATUS.DESCRIPTION: Sync WhatsApp status views to the Evolution instance (Baileys readStatus).

SYNC_FULL_HISTORY.LABEL: Sync full history on connect
SYNC_FULL_HISTORY.DESCRIPTION: Ask Baileys to sync full chat history when the session connects.

ALWAYS_ONLINE.LABEL: Always online presence
ALWAYS_ONLINE.DESCRIPTION: Keep the WhatsApp session presence as available.

MSG_CALL.LABEL: Rejected call message
MSG_CALL.DESCRIPTION: Auto-reply text sent when a call is rejected (requires reject calls enabled).

IGNORE_JIDS.LABEL: Ignored JIDs
IGNORE_JIDS.DESCRIPTION: One JID or pattern per line. Use {'@'}g.us for all groups or a full JID such as 1234567890{'@'}s.whatsapp.net.

ENABLED.LABEL: Enable proxy
ENABLED.DESCRIPTION: Route Baileys traffic through an HTTP or SOCKS proxy. Saving may require reconnecting the instance.

PASSWORD.LABEL: Password
PASSWORD.DESCRIPTION: Leave blank to keep the current password.

PROXY.RESTART_HINT: After changing proxy settings, restart the Evolution instance so Baileys reconnects through the proxy.
PROXY.RESTART_SUCCESS: Proxy saved and instance restart requested.
PROXY.RESTART_ERROR: Could not restart the Evolution instance after saving proxy.

MARK_READ_ON_OPEN.LABEL: Mark incoming as read when opening conversation
MARK_READ_ON_OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Send read receipts to WhatsApp when an agent opens the conversation in Chatwoot.

CONTACTS.LABEL: Import contacts with full profile
CONTACTS.DESCRIPTION: Import WhatsApp contacts from Evolution Go (GET /user/contacts), create them in Chatwoot, and enrich each contact with profile info (POST /user/info) and avatar (POST /user/avatar).

MESSAGES.LABEL: Import message history
MESSAGES.DESCRIPTION: Request chat history per imported contact via POST /chat/history-sync. Messages arrive through the HISTORY_SYNC webhook.

DAYS_LIMIT.LABEL: History window (days)
DAYS_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: Only request messages from the last N days (1–365) for each contact during import.

IMPORT.MESSAGES_REQUIRES_CONTACTS: Message history import runs after contacts are imported (enable Import contacts or run import with both options).

MARK_INBOUND_DELETED.LABEL: Mark client-deleted messages in Chatwoot
MARK_INBOUND_DELETED.DESCRIPTION: When a contact deletes a message on WhatsApp, replace the message text in Chatwoot with a deleted notice. Does not delete anything on WhatsApp.

MARK_INBOUND_EDITED.LABEL: Update client-edited messages in Chatwoot
MARK_INBOUND_EDITED.DESCRIPTION: When a contact edits a message on WhatsApp, update the original message in Chatwoot with the new text and an edited indicator.

SETTINGS.SYNC_DELETE_WARNING: Deleting a message in Chatwoot will also delete it for everyone on WhatsApp. This cannot be undone.
SETTINGS.IMPORT_RUN_WARNING: Contact import runs in the background and may take several minutes for large contact lists. Continue?
SETTINGS.PROXY_CREATE_ONLY: Proxy can only be configured when creating the inbox. To change proxy settings, recreate the Evolution Go instance.
SETTINGS.INBOUND_ONLY_NOTE: These options only update Chatwoot. They do not change or delete anything on WhatsApp.
SETTINGS.API_SYNC_NOTE: These settings are synced to the Evolution Go server when you save.
